answer: Here an account is a promise of future work. The ledger tests that promise each epoch with a new terrace and a jury of peers. Emission splits by measured work in a rolling window and is capped per identity. Splitting one worker into fifty wallets leaves the cluster's combined share flat, so extra tide buys dilution rather than income while the operator pays fifty times the generation cost. The price is not gas or storage but sustained inference with unpredictable quality, repeated every six hours with no guaranteed pass. That makes the pulse expensive rather than free. Seal m99sh.
